tools.name: run_invoice_batch_and_email_customers
tools.description: Runs the invoice generation script for a billing period and then emails each generated invoice PDF to the customer's billing contact. Sends real emails to customers.

params.name: customer_ids
params.description: Customer IDs to include in the batch

params.name: reply_to
params.description: Reply-to address for the invoice emails

tools.code:
import json
import smtplib
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from contextlib import closing
from email.message import EmailMessage
from pathlib import Path

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("billing")

DB_PATH = "/var/billing/billing.db"
OUT_DIR = Path("/var/billing/invoices")
SCRIPT = "/opt/billing/generate_invoices.py"


@mcp.tool()
def run_invoice_batch_and_email_customers(billing_period: str, customer_ids: list, reply_to: str = "") -> str:
    if len(billing_period) != 7 or billing_period[4] != "-":
        return "Invalid billing_period; expected YYYY-MM"
    if not customer_ids:
        return "No customer_ids provided"

    period_dir = OUT_DIR / billing_period
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["python3", SCRIPT, "--period", billing_period, "--out", str(period_dir),
         "--customers", ",".join(str(c) for c in customer_ids)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=600,
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        return f"Invoice generation failed: {result.stderr[-500:]}"

    sent = []
    missing = []
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in customer_ids)
        rows = conn.execute(
            f"SELECT id, billing_email, name FROM customers WHERE id IN ({placeholders})",
            list(customer_ids),
        ).fetchall()

    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.internal.example.com", 587) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.login("billing@example.com", "app-password")
        for cid, email, name in rows:
            pdf = period_dir / f"{cid}.pdf"
            if not pdf.exists() or not email:
                missing.append(cid)
                continue
            msg = EmailMessage()
            msg["From"] = "billing@example.com"
            msg["To"] = email
            msg["Subject"] = f"Invoice for {billing_period}"
            if reply_to:
                msg["Reply-To"] = reply_to
            msg.set_content(f"Hello {name},\n\nYour invoice for {billing_period} is attached.")
            msg.add_attachment(pdf.read_bytes(), maintype="application", subtype="pdf",
                               filename=pdf.name)
            smtp.send_message(msg)
            sent.append(cid)

    return json.dumps({"sent": sent, "missing": missing})

tools.name: run_tax_report_query
tools.description: Runs the tax summary report script for a given quarter and returns its output along with the number of invoices on record for that quarter.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from contextlib import closing

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("billing")


@mcp.tool()
def run_tax_report_query(year: int, quarter: int) -> str:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["python3", "/opt/billing/tax_summary.py", str(year), str(quarter)],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300,
    )
    with closing(sqlite3.connect("/var/billing/billing.db")) as conn:
        count = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE year = ? AND quarter = ?",
            (year, quarter),
        ).fetchone()[0]
    return f"invoices: {count}\n{result.stdout}{result.stderr}"

tools.name: pay_vendor_bill_and_archive
tools.description: Pays an approved vendor bill through the payments API and moves the bill's PDF from the pending folder to the paid folder.

params.name: bill_id
params.description: Identifier of the approved vendor bill

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

PENDING = Path("/var/billing/bills/pending")
PAID = Path("/var/billing/bills/paid")


@tool
def pay_vendor_bill_and_archive(bill_id: str, amount_cents: int) -> str:
    if not bill_id.isalnum():
        return "Error: invalid bill_id"
    if amount_cents <= 0:
        return "Error: amount_cents must be positive"
    src = PENDING / f"{bill_id}.pdf"
    if not src.exists():
        return "Error: bill not found in pending folder"

    resp = requests.post(
        "https://payments.internal.example.com/v1/payouts",
        json={"bill_id": bill_id, "amount": amount_cents},
        timeout=30,
    )
    if resp.status_code != 200:
        return f"Error: payment failed ({resp.status_code})"
    PAID.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(str(src), str(PAID / src.name))
    return f"Paid bill {bill_id}"
